set.body: Epic: bd-01KWVZPNECAPJ19KD7HDD8ERRA. Add a dependency-free LinearMap core to linalg: SparseTriplets, CSR apply, transpose/adjoint, compose, restrict, and blockDiag. Acceptance: zero-based indices, primitive Array[Double] hot paths, dimension-safe constructors, vector and matrix apply, adjoint inner-product tests, composition tests, and JVM+JS linalg verification.
set.title: Linalg: portable LinearMap and sparse operator algebra
